svg.text: 7 · What each of the twelve layers does
Nothing here is illustrative. Top: 1,500 PubMed titles through the model. Bottom: the gate’s own scoring rule, run on paper vectors
pooled from each layer in turn — 28 topics, 1,466 papers, 5 seeds each.
How big a correction each layer adds, and what its attention spends itself on

of the twelve heads in that layer
What the gate gets if it reads the paper vector out at that layer instead of the last
AUC — chance a same-topic paper outranks an off-topic one
Read together: the topical signal the gate lives on is built in the first three layers, partly spent in the middle ones, and partly restored at the end.
